workflows.trigger: Any task that names, implies, or crosses a device, shell, terminal, WSL, Termux, phone, laptop, or profile boundary.
steps: Read AGENTS.md, .ai/harness/device-profile-registry.json, and this harness manifest.
Name the physical host context explicitly: windows-laptop or android-phone.
Name the execution surface explicitly: windows-powershell, windows-cmd, wsl-linux, or android-termux.
Name the target profile explicitly: windows, linux, or android.
Reject remembered device assumptions and commands copied from another profile unless revalidated.
workflows.output: A command envelope ready for deterministic validation.

workflows.trigger: Before presenting an executable operator command that touches a profile-specific surface.
steps: Materialize agentswitchboard.command-envelope.v1.
Run Validate-CommandEnvelope.py.
If windows-laptop targets wsl-linux, require bridgeProof.status=passed and a probe naming wsl.exe plus /bin/bash.
If any Android-only marker appears, require android-phone plus android-termux.
Block a bare bash -lc command on windows-powershell.
Hand off the command only on PASS; otherwise hand off the validator's nextAction instead.
workflows.output: PASS report or BLOCKED report with stable reason codes.

workflows.trigger: A shell, bridge, or profile command fails before the intended repository validator runs.
steps: Preserve the first failure text and identify the actual outer shell.
Do not reinterpret a WSL failure as Android failure or an Android command as laptop work.
If WSL reports configuration warnings or /bin/bash is missing, classify the WSL bridge as unproved and stop downstream Linux commands.
If the command was intended for Android, move the handoff back to android-phone instead of repairing laptop WSL as a substitute.
Regenerate and revalidate a command envelope after the boundary is corrected.
workflows.output: Corrected profile/surface classification and a newly validated next action.

workflows.trigger: Validation is complete or a real external dependency remains.
steps: Record host context, execution surface, target profile, validation status, reason codes, and proof ceiling.
Record the exact next action and its owner/dependency.
Do not claim runtime proof from a static PASS.
Keep local operator evidence untracked and omit secrets.
workflows.output: Human-readable operator report plus machine-readable profile-boundary report.
